areas.name: Lanternholt
areas.description: A fairy-tale village at night: crooked storybook cottages with stained-glass and warm glowing windows, lanterns, a starry purple sky, dense dark trees around it.

areas.name: The Conclave House
areas.description: A gathering of robed wizards (tall, purple and grey robes, pointed hats, long white beards) beside a timber house with warm yellow windows, smoke drifting, a small blue-robed gnome wizard sitting on a bench.

areas.name: Castle Ambermere
areas.description: A sandstone castle with round crenellated towers, starry night sky fading to pink at the horizon, a winding purple cobble path through a bright green grassy hill.

areas.name: The Sentinel Oak
areas.description: A knight resting under a huge tree, crescent moon in a violet sky.

areas.name: Glasswater
areas.description: A knight in shiny plate armor sitting on a rock in a glassy teal lake, tall pines on both sides, violet sky.

areas.name: The Pale Shore
areas.description: A white-robed wizard with a crooked staff standing by dark water, crescent moon, deep blue and purple clouds.

areas.name: The Hollow Pines
areas.description: Teal and green aurora sky above dark pines, a hooded skeleton in a black robe with faintly glowing green bones, a golden skull on the ground in front.

areas.name: Crimsonreach Manor
areas.description: Crimson sky with a huge red moon, a twisted black dead tree framing the left, a dark haunted manor with tall green glowing windows, green light spilling onto the ground.

areas.name: The Road to Vaelmoor Keep
areas.description: A cobblestone road leading straight to a dark spired castle. The stones have a glossy iridescent sheen (orange, pink, teal reflections). Green glowing castle windows, violet and magenta clouds, rocky cliffs on both sides.

areas.name: The Butterfly Pool
areas.description: A woman in a long red embroidered gown with long blond hair, a blue butterfly on her hand, on a curved stone walkway by a glowing turquoise pool. A dark round tower and a huge pale green planet in an olive-green sky.

areas.name: Gnome Strand
areas.description: A gnome camp on a dirt path by a deep blue sea at night: orange-and-green cone tents, small gnomes with tall green hats and blue backpacks walking away, jagged black spires rising from the water, a blinding white moon in swirling blue clouds, weeping trees.

areas.name: The Hermit Stack
areas.description: A log cabin on a flat stone platform on top of a tall green moss-streaked rock pillar, two dark silhouettes standing on the roof, a big blue full moon, starry cloudy night.

areas.name: The Memory of the Sun
areas.description: The only daylight place in the Gloaming: a turquoise mountain lake in a valley of jagged dark peaks with a glacier, a blazing white sun in a deep blue sky with white clouds, pines on a rocky shore.

areas.name: Rootwhistle
areas.description: A storybook tree-house village built into giant trunks: thatched cone roofs, round glowing amber windows, balconies, a curving orange flagstone path with a wooden rail beside a dark blue stream.

areas.name: Court of the Green King
areas.description: A courtyard of dark stone towers at night: a robed king figure with a spiked crown and green-lit face on a stone throne, one hand raised, glowing green vines on the right.

areas.name: Grumblereed Fen
areas.description: A green, mossy troll with one glowing yellow eye and pointed ears, sitting in a wooden boat on dark swamp water under a pale tree.
